# Named Period

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](gmeow-NamedPeriod.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NamedPeriod>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A named stretch of time with defined bounds — a geologic era, historical dynasty, artistic period, fiscal year, or any other culturally salient temporal division.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](gmeow-NamedPeriod.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a culturally or scientifically salient, named division of time that is referenced as an entity — a geologic epoch, dynasty, artistic period, or fiscal year — rather than an ad-hoc interval between two timestamps.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an anonymous bounded span (use [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](gmeow-TimeInterval.md)) and for a point (use [`gmeow:Instant`](gmeow-Instant.md)); a [`NamedPeriod`](gmeow-NamedPeriod.md) is a first-class, identifiable era, not a one-off measurement window.

### How to use

- Classify it with one or more [`gmeow:periodType`](../properties/gmeow-periodType.md) values, bound it with gmeow:periodStart/gmeow:periodEnd (or a [`gmeow:hasTemporalMeasurement`](../properties/gmeow-hasTemporalMeasurement.md) that infers the start via the property chain), and nest it with [`gmeow:periodPartOf`](../properties/gmeow-periodPartOf.md).

### Examples

- ex:victorianEra a [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](gmeow-NamedPeriod.md); [`gmeow:periodType`](../properties/gmeow-periodType.md) [`gmeow:periodTypeHistoricalEra`](../individuals/gmeow-periodTypeHistoricalEra.md); [`gmeow:periodPartOf`](../properties/gmeow-periodPartOf.md) ex:nineteenthCentury.
